# Goal
Falsify declared kama round-39 claims through independent read-only observations. Integration owner is the L1. Every Report trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>.
# Constraints
Lane scratch working copy: /fast/scratch/hyaku/kama-r39. Source repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow, fleet and sibling repos are read-only. Do not edit/commit, mutate lane jj state or lane Git index. Any fixture repository uses D=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$D" init -q; every later git/jj call names -C "$D" explicitly, verify top-level equals D before any commit. Pacman paused host-wide; never run pacman. Tool installation directive: read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; official channels only; record installs. No nested subagent dispatch.
# Claims
C1 calibration 7→7 and C2 coverage 9→9 frozen at base 6a4afdfe48b0b54239d127761d21a5cf21b5b0ea. Do not change predicates. All seats read-only.
# Planner
L1 holds planner seat; a bounded planning walk is inside scout/revenger task items. All wave tasks attack the named item.
